key_insight: Haar-distributed pure-state ensembles maximize basis-free relative entropy ensemble coherence in any finite dimension, linking coherence to quantum communication limits.
engineering_relevance: Ensemble coherence provides theoretical upper bounds on postselection-enabled information gains and the asymptotic secret key rate of qubit B92 QKD.
method: Prove that the normalized Haar ensemble attains a tight coherence upper bound.
Bound the informational advantage of postselective measurements over the Holevo quantity for two equiprobable pure states.
Derive a coherence-based upper bound on the asymptotic B92 secret key rate.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports analytical proofs, with no experimental data or numerical benchmarks described.
watch_item: The results do not establish achievable rates or practical performance under finite-key and hardware-noise constraints.
paper_title: Ensemble basis-free coherence for quantum communication
